Package robbery.outpost

Class CombatManager

java.lang.Object
robbery.outpost.CombatManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Listener
public class CombatManager extends Object implements org.bukkit.event.Listener
Manages combat tagging for players in the Outpost world.

This class prevents combat logging, blocks commands while in combat, and ensures players from the same island cannot damage each other. Tagged players are automatically untagged after a set duration.
